sloka: रूपं च ते प्रजाः सर्वा गमिष्यन्ति न संशयः ।यत्तदेकं समाश्रित्य विभ्रमो ऽयमुपस्थितः ।। ७.३०.३९ ॥
transliteration: rūpaṁ ca te prajāḥ sarvā gamiṣyanti na saṁśayaḥ ।yattadekaṁ samāśritya vibhramo 'yamupasthitaḥ ।। 7.30.39 ॥

translations.english: All creatures will undoubtedly obtain your beauty, having relied upon which unique beauty this delusion has arisen.
